newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Resumes tightening phase.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Resumes tightening phase.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to the dollar bloc resumed Friday's tightening trend which followed the Reserve Bank's official rate cut.

The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread is closing in on the three-year low of around 75 basis points seen immediately after the rate cut, while the three-year yield margin was again brushing with parity.
With the solid profit-taking seen after the rate cut rally now absorbed, traders said investors are seeing value at the short end of the curve, which in turn is supporting longer debt.
A modest firm tone on the resumption of U.S. Treasury trading in Tokyo after Monday's U.S. Memorial Day holiday was also benefitting the local tone.
Canadian bonds were little changed on Monday in the absence of U.S. debt trading, while New Zealand bond yields were easier, underpinned by a slightly stronger local currency.
